verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents an official Go library, the tsnet package, for embedding Tailscale inside a Go program. That is a genuine first-party SDK, but the evidence covers only this one single-language library, and no OpenAPI spec was found to generate API clients. Missing for 10: SDKs beyond Go, an official control-plane/API client SDK, a published OpenAPI spec, in-depth SDK docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with tsnet.
